title: Team Fortress 2
provenance: reported by hayden9002 (highball-db#11), Apple M5 Pro, several sessions, unverified by Highball
notes: Plays. Reported on an M5 Pro: on the built-in ProMotion display with Highball's frame rate limit at 120 and no limit in the game, DXMT, it plays perfectly with raw input on. On an external 60 Hz monitor the frame rate locks to 59.95 on every renderer and the view stutters while the mouse moves (people and items move smoothly when standing still); Kayf-Life shows the same, Portal 2 on the same monitor does not lock and honours fps_max. Not tried here.

anticheat.note: VAC is userspace and runs under Wine; Counter-Strike 2 plays online under it here

knownIssues.symptom: On an external 60 Hz monitor the frame rate locks to 59.95 on every renderer and the view stutters while the mouse moves; raw input on makes it feel better. On the built-in ProMotion display with a 120 fps limit it plays perfectly (M5 Pro, DXMT).
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. Portal 2 on the same monitor exceeds 60 and honours fps_max, so the lock is specific to the game rather than to Wine or the renderer; a vertical sync setting in the game's own video options is the first thing to check.
knownIssues.fix: Reported to work: play on the built-in display with Highball's frame rate limit at 120, raw input on in the game's mouse settings. On a 60 Hz monitor, check the game's video options for vertical sync.
